# Numbering and series (NUM)

How invoice numbers are assigned, which documents need their own series, and why a number is never reused.

Rules page: https://docs.beel.es/rules/numbering

"Checked by: Your integration" or "The issuing business" means BeeL. does not enforce the rule, beyond any error codes it lists: the integration has to.

## Contents

- [NUM-001](#num-001) — The number is assigned when the invoice is issued
- [NUM-002](#num-002) — An issued number is never reused, even when the invoice is voided

## NUM-001

**The number is assigned when the invoice is issued**

`MUST NOT` · BeeL. rule · Impact: critical · Checked by: BeeL. API. BeeL. does this for you.

Do not expect or send an invoice number: a draft has none, and BeeL. assigns the next number of the chosen series when the invoice is issued. Read invoice_number from the response of the issue call.

**Why:** Numbering at issue is what keeps the series free of gaps: a draft deleted before issuing never consumed a number.

**Applies to:** statuses `DRAFT`, `SCHEDULED`, `ISSUED`; operations `issueCompanyInvoice`, `createCompanyInvoice`

**Incorrect:** Storing the draft's id as the invoice number in your system, or computing the next number yourself before issuing.

**Correct:** Issuing the draft and saving the invoice_number the issue call returns.

```http
POST /v1/companies/{company_id}/invoices/{invoice_id}/issue
```

**Related:** NUM-003, NUM-002, LIF-002

**Explained in:** https://docs.beel.es/guides/series-and-numbering#the-number-is-assigned-when-you-issue

**Full rule, with the legal text quoted:** https://docs.beel.es/rules/NUM-001.md

## NUM-002

**An issued number is never reused, even when the invoice is voided**

`MUST NOT` · AEAT criterion · Impact: critical · Checked by: BeeL. API. BeeL. does this for you.

Treat every issued number as consumed for good. A voided invoice, or a test issued in production, keeps its number in the series; the invoice that replaces it gets a new one.

**Why:** The number identifies the invoice in AEAT's records. A second invoice with the same number would be a duplicate that AEAT does not accept.

**Applies to:** statuses `ISSUED`, `SENT`, `PAID`, `RECTIFIED`, `VOIDED`

**Legal basis:**

- AEAT, Preguntas frecuentes SIF y VERI*FACTU, Registros de facturación: anulación — https://sede.agenciatributaria.gob.es/Sede/iva/sistemas-informaticos-facturacion-verifactu/preguntas-frecuentes/registros-facturacion-anulacion.html
- AEAT, Aclaraciones a dudas de los desarrolladores (v1.3), 6. Prohibición de numeración duplicada de un registro — https://www.agenciatributaria.es/static_files/AEAT_Desarrolladores/EEDD/IVA/VERI-FACTU/FAQs-Desarrolladores.pdf

**Incorrect:** Voiding invoice A-2026-0042 and trying to issue its replacement with the same number.

**Correct:** Voiding A-2026-0042 and issuing the replacement as a new invoice, which takes the next number of the series.

**Related:** NUM-001, VOI-001, LIF-003

**Explained in:** https://docs.beel.es/guides/series-and-numbering#the-number-is-assigned-when-you-issue

**Full rule, with the legal text quoted:** https://docs.beel.es/rules/NUM-002.md

## NUM-003

**Numbers are correlative within each series**

`MUST` · Law · Impact: high · Checked by: BeeL. API. BeeL. does this for you.

Within a series, invoice numbers follow one another without gaps or jumps. BeeL. takes the next number of the series at issue, so numbers are only correlative if every invoice of that series is issued through it.

**Why:** A gap or a jump in a series is what an inspection reads as a missing invoice.

**Applies to:** invoice types `STANDARD`, `SIMPLIFIED`, `CORRECTIVE`

**Legal basis:**

- RD 1619/2012 (Reglamento de facturación), art. 6.1.a) — https://www.boe.es/buscar/act.php?id=BOE-A-2012-14696#a6

**Incorrect:** Issuing some invoices of series A from another system while BeeL. issues the rest of the same series.

**Correct:** Giving each system its own series, or continuing an old sequence in BeeL. by setting the series' initial number before its first invoice.

**Related:** NUM-001, NUM-004, NUM-007

**Explained in:** https://docs.beel.es/guides/series-and-numbering#how-the-counter-works · https://docs.beel.es/guides/series-and-numbering#continuing-a-sequence-from-another-system

**Full rule, with the legal text quoted:** https://docs.beel.es/rules/NUM-003.md

## NUM-004

**Separate series may be used when there is a reason for them**

`SHOULD` · Law · Impact: low · Checked by: The issuing business. BeeL. does not check this; you must.

You may number invoices in separate series when there is a reason, such as several establishments or operations of a different nature. Create one series per establishment or line of business and pick it when you create the invoice.

**Why:** Mixing establishments in one series makes the sequence hard to follow; the law lets you keep them apart.

**Applies to:** operations `createCompanySeries`

**Legal basis:**

- RD 1619/2012 (Reglamento de facturación), art. 6.1.a) — https://www.boe.es/buscar/act.php?id=BOE-A-2012-14696#a6

**Incorrect:** Creating a new series every month to restart the count, with no establishment or kind of operation behind it.

**Correct:** Creating series SHOP and ONLINE for a business that sells in a shop and on the web, and sending each invoice's series_id.

**Related:** NUM-003, NUM-005, NUM-006

**Explained in:** https://docs.beel.es/guides/series-and-numbering#default-series-per-document-type

**Full rule, with the legal text quoted:** https://docs.beel.es/rules/NUM-004.md

## NUM-005

**Simplified invoices are numbered in their own series**

`MUST` · Law · Impact: high · Checked by: BeeL. API. BeeL. rejects a request that breaks it.

A business that issues both full and simplified invoices in the same calendar year numbers them in separate series. A typed BeeL. series accepts only its own document type, so keep one series for each type.

**Why:** Full and simplified invoices sharing a series would leave neither sequence correlative.

**Applies to:** invoice types `SIMPLIFIED`, `STANDARD`; operations `createCompanyInvoice`, `issueCompanyInvoice`

**Error codes:** [`SERIES_DOCUMENT_TYPE_INCOMPATIBLE`](https://docs.beel.es/errors/SERIES_DOCUMENT_TYPE_INCOMPATIBLE), [`SERIES_INCOMPATIBLE_DOC_TYPE`](https://docs.beel.es/errors/SERIES_INCOMPATIBLE_DOC_TYPE)

**Legal basis:**

- RD 1619/2012 (Reglamento de facturación), art. 7.1.a) — https://www.boe.es/buscar/act.php?id=BOE-A-2012-14696#a7

**Incorrect:** Creating a SIMPLIFIED invoice with the series_id of your standard-invoice series: it is rejected with SERIES_DOCUMENT_TYPE_INCOMPATIBLE.

**Correct:** Omitting series_id, so the default series for simplified invoices is used, or passing a series created for that type.

**Related:** NUM-004, NUM-006, SIM-001

**Explained in:** https://docs.beel.es/guides/series-and-numbering#default-series-per-document-type

**Full rule, with the legal text quoted:** https://docs.beel.es/rules/NUM-005.md

## NUM-006

**Corrective invoices are numbered in their own series**

`MUST` · Law · Impact: high · Checked by: BeeL. API. BeeL. rejects a request that breaks it.

Corrective invoices go in a series specific to correctives, never in the series of ordinary invoices. Without a series_id, BeeL. numbers a corrective in the default corrective series; a typed series of another type is rejected.

**Why:** The law requires correctives to be told apart from ordinary invoices by their series.

**Applies to:** invoice types `CORRECTIVE`; operations `createCompanyCorrectiveInvoice`

**Error codes:** [`SERIES_DOCUMENT_TYPE_INCOMPATIBLE`](https://docs.beel.es/errors/SERIES_DOCUMENT_TYPE_INCOMPATIBLE), [`SERIES_INCOMPATIBLE_DOC_TYPE`](https://docs.beel.es/errors/SERIES_INCOMPATIBLE_DOC_TYPE)

**Legal basis:**

- RD 1619/2012 (Reglamento de facturación), art. 6.1.a) — https://www.boe.es/buscar/act.php?id=BOE-A-2012-14696#a6

**Incorrect:** Passing the series_id of your ordinary series when creating a corrective invoice.

**Correct:** Omitting series_id on the corrective, so the default corrective series numbers it.

```http
POST /v1/companies/{company_id}/invoices/{invoice_id}/corrective

{ "rectification_type": "TOTAL", "rectification_code": "R1", "reason": "Invoice issued with the wrong VAT rate" }
```

**Related:** NUM-005, COR-002

**Explained in:** https://docs.beel.es/guides/series-and-numbering#correctives-and-proformas

**Full rule, with the legal text quoted:** https://docs.beel.es/rules/NUM-006.md

## NUM-007

**A series cannot be renumbered once it has issued**

`MUST NOT` · BeeL. rule · Impact: medium · Checked by: BeeL. API. BeeL. rejects a request that breaks it.

Once a series has issued an invoice, its code, format, reset policy and initial number are fixed. Design the series before its first invoice; to number differently, create a new series.

**Why:** Changing how an issued series is numbered would rewrite numbers already registered with AEAT or break the sequence.

**Applies to:** operations `patchCompanySeries`

**Error codes:** [`SERIES_NUMBERING_FROZEN`](https://docs.beel.es/errors/SERIES_NUMBERING_FROZEN), [`SERIES_CODE_LOCKED_HAS_INVOICES`](https://docs.beel.es/errors/SERIES_CODE_LOCKED_HAS_INVOICES)

**Incorrect:** Changing the format of series A after it has issued invoices, to add the year: it is rejected with SERIES_NUMBERING_FROZEN.

**Correct:** Creating a new series with the new format and making it the default for new invoices.

**Related:** NUM-003, NUM-004

**Explained in:** https://docs.beel.es/guides/series-and-numbering#a-series-locks-once-it-has-issued

**Full rule, with the legal text quoted:** https://docs.beel.es/rules/NUM-007.md

## NUM-008

**An invoice number fits AEAT's length and character set**

`MUST` · AEAT criterion · Impact: high · Checked by: AEAT. AEAT rejects a record that breaks it.

The full invoice number, series prefix included, is at most 60 characters and uses only printable ASCII characters, without double quotes, single quotes, less-than, greater-than or equals signs. Choose series codes and formats that keep every number within these limits.

**Why:** AEAT identifies the invoice by this number, in the record and in the QR. A number outside these limits is rejected by AEAT after the invoice has been issued and numbered.

**Applies to:** operations `createCompanySeries`, `patchCompanySeries`; VeriFactu enabled.

**Legal basis:**

- AEAT, Validaciones y errores VERI*FACTU (v1.2.2), 3.1.3.1 Agrupación IDFactura — https://www.agenciatributaria.es/static_files/AEAT_Desarrolladores/EEDD/IVA/VERI-FACTU/Validaciones_Errores_Veri-Factu.pdf
- AEAT, Detalle de las especificaciones técnicas del código QR de la factura (v0.5.0), apartado 6, parámetro numserie — https://www.agenciatributaria.es/static_files/AEAT_Desarrolladores/EEDD/IVA/VERI-FACTU/DetalleEspecificacTecnCodigoQRfactura.pdf

**Incorrect:** A series format that produces numbers like SHOP=2026/"0001", with characters AEAT does not accept.

**Correct:** A series format that produces short numbers such as SHOP-2026-0001.

**Related:** NUM-007, QRC-005

**Explained in:** https://docs.beel.es/guides/series-and-numbering#the-format

**Full rule, with the legal text quoted:** https://docs.beel.es/rules/NUM-008.md

## NUM-009

**Reverse-charge supplies of metals and electronics go in a special series**

`MUST` · Law · Impact: low · Checked by: The issuing business. BeeL. does not check this; you must.

Invoices for supplies of silver, platinum, palladium, mobile phones, game consoles, laptops or tablets in which the buyer is liable for the VAT are issued in a special series. Create a dedicated series and use it for these invoices.

**Why:** The law requires these reverse-charge supplies to be documented in their own series; mixing them with other invoices breaks that requirement.

**Applies to:** invoice types `STANDARD`; Supplies of silver, platinum, palladium, mobile phones, game consoles, laptops or tablets where the buyer is liable for VAT.

**Legal basis:**

- Ley 37/1992 del IVA, art. 84.Uno.2.º g) — https://www.boe.es/buscar/act.php?id=BOE-A-1992-28740#a84
- RD 1619/2012 (Reglamento de facturación), art. 6.1.a) 4.º — https://www.boe.es/buscar/act.php?id=BOE-A-2012-14696#a6

**Incorrect:** Invoicing a batch of laptops to a reseller in the same series as the rest of your sales.

**Correct:** Creating a series such as ISP-G and issuing those invoices in it.

**Related:** NUM-004, TAX-002, CNT-012

**Full rule, with the legal text quoted:** https://docs.beel.es/rules/NUM-009.md
